mechanism: 4 isolated sleeves: micro-cap + 红利ETF MA250 + two ETF momentum rotations
entry: daily 14:50 main_trade; sleeve-11 signals executed 13:05 / next-day 09:35; monthly 10:00 rebalance
evidence: initialize() sets 3 subportfolios and g.strategies=[Strategy11(0),Strategy12(1),Strategy13(1),Strategy14(2)] at weights [0.2,0.2,0.3,0.3]; main_trade loops st.trade(context) at run_daily 14:50. Strategy11 = '微盘股择时': min_mv 10 / max_mv 100 亿, low_price 2 / high_price 10, ma_day_1 10 / ma_day_2 26, sell_limit 1.27, loss_percent 0.15, plus a self-built 200-name 微盘股 half-day index with an EMA-26 channel and dd_thresholds [-0.06,-0.12,-0.20] driving channel_position (position SIZE timing, not stock selection). Strategy12 = single 512890.XSHG vs its own 250-day MA (ratio_low<buy_threshold buy / ratio_high>sell_threshold flat, l.1112-1145). Strategy13 = 5-ETF rotation on 20-day return with bias20/60/250 caps, cash leg 511880.XSHG, 5-day cooldown, -6% stop (l.1158-1199). Strategy14 = '多因子ETF动量' over overseas/commodity/domestic pools with a defensive ETF (l.1310-1320, 1521-1572). high_limit is used to SCREEN OUT, not to chase: BaseStrategy._order returns False when amount>0 and last_price>=high_limit (l.71-72), and check_limit_up only SELLS a held yesterday-limit-up once it opens below high_limit (l.778-783). Not assigned: this is a combination book embedding several lineages at once (a 小市值-shaped stock sleeve + two ETF-rotation sleeves), exactly the case family-match abstains on by design.

sourceFile: strategies/2026-10-27_ETF低相关策略的聚宽实现_EPO优化器与资产配置实战-042aea4d.py
mechanism: EPO shrinkage-covariance weights over a 10-ETF low-correlation pool
evidence: g.etf_pool = 10 cross-asset ETFs (159985 豆粕, 518800/159930 黄金, 513000 日经, 513100 纳指, 513030 德国, 159981 原油, 159980 有色, 510880 红利, 510230 金融) (l.18). epo() implements the Enhanced Portfolio Optimization shrinkage: shrunk_cor=((1-w)*I@corr)+(w*I), cov_tilde=std@shrunk_cor@std, epo=(1/lambda)*inv_shrunk_cov@signal with lambda_=10, w=0.6, negative weights clipped and renormalized (l.22-52). run_optimization uses 250 daily closes to previous_date and an inverse-variance signal a=(1/d)/(1/d).sum() (l.55-62). trade() then order_target_value(s, total_value*weights[s]) for every pool member (l.65-72); filter_new_stock drops names listed <30 days (l.74-76). No cross-sectional return ranking anywhere, so it is not ETF动量/七星高照; kept separate from the fixed-weight allocators because the weights are re-derived from the covariance each month.

mechanism: SCHD methodology: dividend-quality four-factor score, top 100 yield-weighted
evidence: _base_filter drops ST/退/科创(68)/北交(920,4,8)/创业板(300,301) and names listed <365 days (l.118-138). _screen_fundamentals requires circulating_market_cap >= pool P15 quantile, fcf = net_operate_cash_flow - fix_intan_other_asset_acqui_cash > 0, inc_return > 0, with total_debt built from four balance-sheet loan lines (l.141-170). Declared funnel (header l.10-12 + constants l.30-46): 10 consecutive dividend years (SCHD_MIN_DIVIDEND_YEARS=10), trailing yield 1%-15%, 5-year dividend growth >= 0, four equal-weight factors (FCF/total debt, ROE, yield, 5y growth), SCHD_TOP_N=100 weighted by yield with SCHD_MAX_SINGLE_WEIGHT 0.04 and SCHD_SECTOR_CAP 0.25. Risk block explicitly has no stop-loss and no drawdown overlay (l.15). high_limit: prepare_limit_list at 09:00 + check_limit_up at 10:00 SELL a held name once its limit-up opens (l.100-102) — an exit, not a chase. NEW rather than 红利低频: 100 names yield-weighted monthly off a quality score shares no code and no construction with base 93379f98's 10-name 股息率 x 低换手 25-day book; 'dividend' is a theme, not a lineage.

sourceFile: strategies/2026-10-21_一个适合上班族懒人定投的资产配置策略_年化13-c65b0c1e.py
mechanism: Fixed 6-ETF weights, daily drift-band rebalance to target value
evidence: g.assets = 518880 黄金 0.15 / 159985 豆粕 0.05 / 501018 原油 0.05 / 512890 红利 0.25 / 159941 纳指 0.20 / 511220 城投债 0.30 (l.20-27). rebalance() is the whole strategy: first pass trims any holding where current_value > target*1.01 and the gap exceeds min_trade_value=3000, second pass tops up where current_value < target*0.99 or the position is absent, both via order_target_value (l.33-65). 67 lines total — no selection, no signal, no indicator. Same mechanism class as b1531180 and c913387f (constant weight vector + a rebalance trigger), so the NEW name is deliberately reused; ⚠ the three are different authors and share no code, so if a family is registered they are three independent lineages implementing one mechanism, not one lineage.

sourceFile: strategies/2026-10-17_量化分享_ETF低波海龟法则与复利增强的验证-4a8bcfd5.py
mechanism: Hold the single lowest-60d-vol ETF, turtle ATR unit pyramiding, 4N stop
evidence: Selection is LOW VOLATILITY, not momentum: get_vol_rank returns 60-day annualized log-return std sorted ASCENDING (l.106-133) and rebalance_trade takes best = vol.index[0] (l.393), enforcing one holding by liquidating held[1:] (l.403-407). Pool = 14 risk ETFs (g.all_risk_etfs l.43-58) plus two bond ETFs (g.safe_etfs l.60-63) admitted only when risk_vol_median > g.risk_vol_median_threshold 0.40 (l.376-386). Turtle sizing: get_atr_n computes N as the 20-day EMA of true range (l.136-165); add_position fires when price >= last_entry_price + 1.0*N, max_units 4, initial_units 3, stop at price - 4N, per-unit risk 1% capped at 4% total (l.82-91, 300-370). Take-profit at +30% of cost selling half the profit (l.73-74). Header cites 聚宽 post/78820 as the parent book, so a lineage may exist OUTSIDE the 13 registered families; within them, ETF动量/七星高照 rank by 25-day regression slope x R-squared, the opposite end of the vol ordering, so no existing family fits.

mechanism: Permanent-portfolio fixed weights plus Nasdaq drawdown-triggered overweight
entry: run_daily(daily_check_and_trade,'10:30'); trades only on first build or a trigger
evidence: g.base_weights = 510880 红利 0.125+0.30*0.15, 511990 短融 0.30*0.85+0.25, 513100 纳指 0.125, 162411 油气LOF 0.10, 518880 黄金 0.10 (l.84-90), chosen as longer-history stand-ins for 512890/511360/513350 (l.63-67). Overlay: g.nasdaq_drawdown_steps [(-0.20,0.375),(-0.10,0.250)] lifts the Nasdaq target when its price falls that far below the YEAR peak, funded out of 短融; weights revert to base on an all-time Nasdaq high; a new calendar year only resets the year peak and does NOT rebalance (l.92-107, header l.25-37). daily_check_and_trade reads get_last_close (previous session close), so the trigger carries no intraday lookahead (l.110-130). Benchmark is set to 513100, not 000300 (l.47). Same fixed-weight class as b1531180 / c65b0c1e, with an event overlay rather than a calendar one; no code shared with either.
